subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails` be suppressed before mutating-warning handling, including cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail paths, or should those detail paths remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally surface some exec details, while the PR asserts all exec-like includeDetails warnings should be hidden; choosing that contract changes user-visible failure reporting.

options.title: Clarify policy and repair ordering
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract, then revise the branch order and tests to match it across normal, cron, heartbeat, and verbose paths.

options.title: Keep detail-mode warnings visible
options.body: Preserve the current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose warning behavior and narrow or close the linked report as an unsupported suppress-all request.

options.title: Accept the narrow guard change
options.body: Merge the one-line change knowing it only affects non-mutating exec-like errors and does not fully resolve the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Clarify policy and repair ordering
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract, then revise the branch order and tests to match it across normal, cron, heartbeat, and verbose paths.
